# RAG chunking guidelines
1. Extract text with page numbers and section headings.
2. Preserve tables with headers, units, and notes.
3. Chunk by meaningful sections/paragraphs.
4. Attach source ID, title, URL, page, section, family, and chunk ID.
5. Keep results with test conditions, units, and limitations.
6. Separate exact extracts from paraphrases and AI summaries.
7. Human-review Q&A before production indexing.
8. Require citations and abstain when evidence is insufficient.
